import { defineKind, spawn } from '../entity/entity.ts';
import { onStart } from '../loop.ts';
import { createOwnedView } from '../render/owned-view.ts';
import { instantiate, workshopChair } from '../prefab/instantiate.ts';

defineKind('review-legitimate-a', { update: 31 });
onStart(() => {
  const owner = createOwnedView();
  const placement = { ...workshopChair, id: 'review-legitimate-a' };
  const chair = instantiate(placement.prefab, placement, { owner });
  chair.setEnabled(true);
  spawn({ kind: 'review-legitimate-a', mesh: owner.root, update: owner.update, dispose: owner.dispose });
});
